items.caption: A modern reconstruction in Shuowen seal-script style shows the received form 眞. Shuowen parses it through 𠤎, 目, 乚, and 八, a later account distinct from analyses of the Western Zhou bronze forms.
items.alt: Black seal-script graph with a tall left stroke, a curved upper stroke, a rounded central enclosure holding two horizontal bars, and two descending lower strokes.
items.selection_reason: It provides a visible example of the received seal-script tradition for comparison with the reported bronze forms, while its later parsing does not establish the bronze graph’s origin.

limitations.text: This reconstruction is not a dated artifact. The received Shuowen interpretation does not establish the Western Zhou bronze graph’s referent or original meaning, which remain disputed.
